const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"tmp_dir=/tmp/repair-w66-execute-03.A4jvTX
total=0
for file in mod-tome.lua tome-ashes-urhrok.lua tome-cults.lua tome-orcs.lua; do
  count=$(jq -n --slurpfile b "$tmp_dir/baseline-$file.jsonl" --slurpfile c "$tmp_dir/current-$file.jsonl" '[range(0; ($b|length)) | select(($b[.]|del(.line)) != ($c[.]|del(.line)))] | length') || exit $?
  jq -e -n --slurpfile b "$tmp_dir/baseline-$file.jsonl" --slurpfile c "$tmp_dir/current-$file.jsonl" '($b|length)==($c|length) and ([range(0; ($b|length)) | select(($b[.]|del(.line)) != ($c[.]|del(.line))) | (($b[.]|del(.target,.line)) == ($c[.]|del(.target,.line)) and ($b[.].target != $c[.].target)] | all)' >/dev/null || exit $?
  total=$((total + count))
done
test "$total" -eq 25 || exit 1
test "$(rg -F -o '面向大海，对于……额，德雷德菲……' mod-tome.lua | wc -l)" -eq 0 || exit 1
test "$(rg -F -o '奔向大海，去……，还有恐惧王……' mod-tome.lua | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 1
printf 'aggregate_changed_targets=%s\nonly_target_fields_changed=true\ntarget_phrase_assertions=OK\n' "$total"","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":10000}); text(r.output);
